To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
physical exercise is recommended as a non-pharmaceutical treatment for hypertension and the training status may influence the relationship between blood uric acid levels and BP.
the functional fitness index is associated with uric acid, nitrite and lipid profile in adults and elderly.
physical exercise may reduce BP by decreasing UA and increasing nitrite production.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the importance of functional fitness in the prevention of hypertension and cardiovascular diseases.
the relationship between training status and blood pressure.
the importance of physical training for prevention and treatment of hypertension.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the functional fitness index is associated with the BP and UA and may be used as a predictor of these variables.
the training status is able to modulate BP and oxidative stress, which may be related to the UA levels.
the relationship between UA, BP and training status can be explained by the fact that UA is a powerful oxidant and its production may be related to the oxidative stress produced during exercise.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the physical fitness status may have an important role in the prevention and control of high blood pressure.
the functional fitness index may be a useful tool to prevent and/or treat the hypertension in adults and elderly.
the functional fitness index may be an important predictor for blood pressure, uric acid and oxidative stress.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the functional fitness index is a good indicator of the health status of the individual.
the physical fitness status is an important variable that may influence blood pressure, uric acid, lipid profile and nitrite concentration.
physical exercise is an important strategy to prevent and/or treat high blood pressure.
